# Icarus, or the Future of Science

*[Russell](../philosophers/russell.md) · 1924*

A short essay written in reply to Haldane's Daedalus, which promised happiness through biology. Russell turns the image around: science confers power, and power serves whatever ends those who receive it already have, so that a new technique improves nothing by itself.
